janmabalapravṛttarogaḥ जन्मबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Congenital anomalies
Conditions that occur at the time of birth which may be the result of diet and lifestyle choices by the mother during conception or from non-fulfilment of maternal cravings during pregnancy.

ITA-9.2.26 jānubastiḥ जानुबस्तिः
Therapeutic retention of oil over knee region
A procedure which involves holding medicated oil over the knee region for a specific duration.

ITA-3.13.53 jānvadhaḥsandhiḥ जान्वधःसन्धिः
Proximal tibiofibular joint
